chart.title: Prevalence rate of diabetes in adults
chart.subtitle: Estimated share of people with diabetes among those aged over 18, based on general population surveys and statistical modeling. Diabetes is a risk factor for chronic complications, including cardiovascular disease, and premature death.
chart.note: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized.
chart.citation: World Health Organization – Global Health Observatory (2026)
